name: Justin King
title: Broadcast Engineer
bio: Justin is an experienced broadcast engineer and live events professional with a strong command of Disguise, Barco, and Notch workflows. Whether managing a broadcast truck or running video systems for a live show, he brings the same sharp technical expertise and calm professionalism to every production.

projects.title: Broadcast Productions
projects.desc: Broadcast engineering for large-scale live productions, managing redundant video systems, real-time switching, and content delivery for global streaming audiences.

projects.title: Corporate & Conference Events
projects.desc: Technical lead for high-profile corporate events requiring broadcast-quality video output, multi-screen Barco setups, and precise real-time content management.

projects.title: Live Concert & Tour Productions
projects.desc: Broadcast engineer on major touring productions, adapting video and broadcast systems across venues while maintaining consistent output quality nightly.

projects.title: Streaming & Virtual Events
projects.desc: Technical director for live streaming and virtual event productions, managing end-to-end video workflows and ensuring broadcast-quality delivery for global online audiences.
